_why: The Phase-5 shell gate admits `h_mad_assemble_tdd.py --authors-test`. Each mutant loosens one refusal of that rule, unwires it, or drops the admit.

mutations.name: authoring-rule-always-allows
mutations._mechanism: Every authoring path is admitted.

mutations.name: authoring-any-phase
mutations._mechanism: RED/GREEN dispatches may name authored tests.
mutations.find: if values["--phase"] != ["gate"] or len(roots) != 1 or _cwd_escapes_root(root, cwd):

mutations.name: authoring-first-phase-wins
mutations._mechanism: argparse keeps the last --phase; judging the first vouches for a phase not used.
mutations.find: if values["--phase"] != ["gate"] or len(roots) != 1 or _cwd_escapes_root(root, cwd):
mutations.replace: if values["--phase"][:1] != ["gate"] or len(roots) != 1 or _cwd_escapes_root(root, cwd):

mutations.name: authoring-repeated-root
mutations._mechanism: argparse keeps the last --project-root; judging the first vouches for a root not used.
mutations.find: if values["--phase"] != ["gate"] or len(roots) != 1 or _cwd_escapes_root(root, cwd):
mutations.replace: if values["--phase"] != ["gate"] or not roots or _cwd_escapes_root(root, cwd):

mutations.name: authoring-cwd-outside-root
mutations._mechanism: A workdir outside the root falls back to the root and is judged there.
mutations.find: if values["--phase"] != ["gate"] or len(roots) != 1 or _cwd_escapes_root(root, cwd):

mutations.name: authoring-root-value-unchecked
mutations._mechanism: An option-shaped value is read as the project root.

mutations.name: authoring-empty-root
mutations._mechanism: An empty --project-root is read as the working directory.

mutations.name: authoring-root-may-leave-the-project
mutations._mechanism: --project-root .. names files outside the gated root.

mutations.name: authoring-dash-value
mutations._mechanism: An option-shaped value is taken as a path.
mutations.find: if value.startswith("-") or path.is_absolute() or ".." in path.parts:

mutations.name: authoring-absolute-path
mutations._mechanism: An absolute path is admitted.
mutations.find: if value.startswith("-") or path.is_absolute() or ".." in path.parts:

mutations.name: authoring-dotdot
mutations._mechanism: A .. component is admitted when it lands inside.
mutations.find: if value.startswith("-") or path.is_absolute() or ".." in path.parts:

mutations.name: authoring-target-may-leave
mutations._mechanism: A linked directory carries the target outside the project.

mutations.name: authoring-target-name-unchecked
mutations._mechanism: A test-named link to production code is admitted.

mutations.name: authoring-path-name-unchecked
mutations._mechanism: A production-named link to a test is admitted.

mutations.name: authoring-rule-unwired
mutations._mechanism: The rule exists and nothing calls it.

mutations.name: authoring-cwd-unwired
mutations._mechanism: The command's directory never reaches the rule, so a relative root is judged from the project root.
mutations.find: return _safe_hmad_script(script, argv[2:], root or Path.cwd(), cwd)

mutations.name: authoring-option-not-admitted
mutations._mechanism: The pre-fix gate: an approved gate task cannot name the test it authors.

mutations.name: authoring-node-id
mutations._mechanism: A pytest node id of production code ends in a test-shaped name and is admitted.

mutations.name: authoring-last-value-only
mutations._mechanism: argparse appends; judging only the last value admits a bad one before it.

mutations.name: authoring-malformed-workdir
mutations._mechanism: A workdir codex sent that is not a string is judged from the root.
